messages:
maria: FYI support ticket from ACME — they say invoice is ~38% higher than dashboard for Feb 14-15. customer says they saw an ingestion outage that day. can we confirm?
jonathan: opened incident for ingestion lag earlier today, we had an eventstore spike 02/15 03:10-04:45 UTC. looks like some kafka consumer laged.
sam: what does 'higher' mean — tokens or requests?
maria: tokens. customer provided screenshots: dashboard shows ~1.2M tokens, invoice shows 1.66M. customer is asking for explanation/credit.
ashley: tagging billing-bot for visibility @billing-bot
billing-bot: Billing alert: invoice #ACME-202602 issued 2026-02-20 shows usage 1,659,872 tokens. Last synced ledger: 1,200,134 tokens.
lee: ok start triage: 1) confirm event ingestion window, 2) check replay/backfill runs for that window, 3) run dry-run delta to estimate extra tokens before any adjustments.
jonathan: ingestion window confirmed: 2026-02-15T03:10:00Z -> 2026-02-15T04:45:00Z had consumer group 'ingest-processor' lag of ~1.8M messages. some got reprocessed during recovery.
sam: is there a single replay job for that window? what's the job id?
jonathan: replay job id: replay-20260215-0310. ran at 2026-02-15T05:00Z and again at 05:45Z. second run logged an error then retried.
maria: can you paste the replay logs?
jonathan: here — truncated:
```
[05:47:12] replay-20260215-0310 ERROR: event_id=0x7f2a checksum mismatch expected=0x5af3 got=0x4b22
[05:47:12] skipping event event_id=0x7f2a (legacy-encoding)
[05:47:15] replay completed with warnings, processed=1,820,012, skipped=6
```
sam: checksum mismatches are our old bug from the archive schema change. skipping might change token accounting if duplicates are re-ingested by fallback path.
lee: before we touch anything, run the dry-run delta tool to compute what the replay would add to the ledger without writing. command:
```
./tools/replay-dryrun --job replay-20260215-0310 --from 2026-02-15T03:00:00Z --to 2026-02-15T05:00:00Z --output delta.json
```
ashley: I ran that on a fork and got delta.json -> {"estimated_tokens": "460738", "unique_sessions": "12,402"} (so ~460k extra tokens which matches the invoice delta).
jonathan: that suggests double-counting: some events were both in original ingest and then reprocessed to ledger during backfill. we need to confirm idempotency keys for those events.
sam: quick check query to compare eventstream->ledger mapping:
```
SELECT e.event_id, l.token_count, COUNT(*) as ledger_rows
FROM events e
JOIN ledger l ON l.event_id = e.event_id
WHERE e.timestamp BETWEEN '2026-02-15T03:00:00Z' AND '2026-02-15T05:00:00Z'
GROUP BY e.event_id, l.token_count
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
lee: run that on staging first. if it returns rows => duplicates in ledger.
maria: ran on staging subset, got ~3k duplicated rows. sample event_ids attached to ticket.
billing-bot: Note: there was a manual invoice adjustment on 2026-02-22 for another customer in the same org due to reconciliation; no automated credits issued for ACME.
sam: mitigation plan: 1) run full dry-run for the window to get true delta 2) if delta > 0, open a billing ticket and prepare provisional credit 3) fix replay job to enforce idempotency / strict checksum handling 4) re-run backfill in 'strict' mode with de-dup protection.
jonathan: for immediate action I'm going to re-run replay-dryrun with --full-check and timestamps for the entire affected hour.
jonathan: running now, ETA ~12m.
(sre-bot): replay-dryrun started by jonathan at 2026-02-21T16:20:00Z for job replay-20260215-0310
jonathan: dry-run finished. output: estimated_tokens=459,738 ; estimated_duplicates=47,112 ; note: duplicates mostly on session_id range: s-20000..s-30000
maria: ok that lines up with invoice diff. next: billing needs an explanation + credit. who owns customer comms?
ashley: I'll draft the customer message: explain outage -> reprocessing caused duplicate ledger entries -> offering provisional credit of 460k tokens worth (rounded) while we reconcile. will include timeline and next steps.
billing-bot: Create billing ticket: BT-2026-387 created referencing invoice ACME-202602 and delta 459,738 tokens.
lee: engineering fixes: create PR to 1) fail hard on checksum mismatch during replay (config flag controlled), 2) add idempotency key check before ledger write, 3) add post-replay reconciliation step that compares dry-run delta vs ledger rows.
jonathan: opened PR #3124 with tests, marking for urgent review.
sam: ops runbook step: before applying any ledger corrections we run a golden-check against the customer-facing dashboard and generate a reconciliation report. command to compute ledger tokens for window:
```
./tools/ledger-sum --from '2026-02-15T03:00:00Z' --to '2026-02-15T05:00:00Z' --format json > ledger_window.json
jq '.total_tokens' ledger_window.json
```
maria: action items for this thread: - ashley: send customer draft + provisional credit - jonathan: confirm PR and deploy hotfix to replay flags - lee: run de-dup job in dry-run then in strict mode - sam: prepare reconciliation report and billing ticket details.
ashley: sending draft now, will paste here for review.
ashley: draft pasted -> short and apologetic, includes credit estimate, timeline for root cause and fix, and offer of technical postmortem call. :email:
maria: thanks team. keep thread updated when PR merges and when ledger corrections are scheduled.
jonathan: PR merged to canary at 2026-02-21T17:05Z. replay strict mode tested on canary — no duplicates on test window. scheduling strict backfill for 2026-02-21T22:30Z (maintenance window).
sam: please record final reconciliation numbers and confirm credit issuance once job is complete.
(sre-bot): backfill job replay-20260215-0310-strict started at 2026-02-21T22:30:12Z by jonathan
jonathan: strict backfill completed with report attached: final_added_tokens=459,512 ; duplicates_prevented=46,900 ; ledger_final_window_tokens=1,659,646
maria: billing ticket BT-2026-387 updated with final numbers and credit request for 459,512 tokens. customer notified with draft + credit.
ashley: customer replied: appreciated proactive handling, will accept credit. closing loop once invoice is updated. :thumbsup:
lee: postmortem todo: add monitoring alert for replay-dryrun delta > 5% of dashboard window and add automatic dry-run after any large consumer lag event.
maria: closing this thread for now; reopen if billing or customer escalates. Thanks everyone.
